## 游戏内容介绍


一个酝酿了 216 年的活祭品，一出生就被叫作「最后的罪人」，某天发现了比赴死更有趣的事，于是走出了牢房。纸质童话书风格的互动奇幻冒险，手绘逐格动画。截图有蓝调牢房、圆形大厅、书架回廊。

### Steam 商店简介（原文摘录）〔Steam商店页〕

> 「她生来就是一份酝酿了 216 年的祭品——直到她发现了比死更有趣的东西，走出了牢房。一部来自香港的手绘逐帧动画视觉小说：阅读、选择，然后连打、驾驶、拖拽、战斗、搜寻，一路完成她的逃亡。」（原文："She was born to be a sacrifice 216 years in the making — until she found something more interesting than dying, and walked out of her cell. A hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animated visual novel from Hong Kong: read, choose, then mash, drive, drag, fight and search your way through her escape."）

>  「这是一场发生在纸质童话绘本里的互动奇幻冒险。在很远很远的地方，有一份酝酿了 216 年的活祭品。然而那个注定成为祭品的人——自出生起就以「最后的罪人」之名活着的她——第一次发现了比赴死更吸引人的东西。于是，她走出了牢房。这是她自我发现的旅程。- 使用了纸、布、纽扣等多种材料 - 故事以动画和视觉小说形式讲述，途中有各种互动小游戏。计划还有七章。等待下一章时，可以去官网看插画、表情包和小动画。- 来自香港的原创独立游戏——一人制作的视觉小说／奇幻冒……」（原文："This is an interactive fantasy adventure in a paper fairy tale storybook In a land far, far away, there was a living sacrifice that had been 216 years in the making. And yet the one who was to be that sacrifice — she who had lived since birth under the name of 'the Last Sinner' — discovered, for the very first time, something far more intriguing than going to her death. And so, she walked out of her cell. This is her journey of self-discovery. - The materials used included a variety of items such as paper, cloth, and buttons - The story will told by animation and visual novel format, and there are various interactive games along the way. Plan to have seven more chapters. While you're waiting for the next chapter, you can check out the illustrations, memes, and mini-animations on the official website. - An indie original game from Hong Kong — a one-person-made visual novel / fantasy adve"）
